# Feature status

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-feature-docs.mjs from the data; edit the data, then run it again. -->

Which of Dayspring's features are finished, new, or still being built, and which version has them. The owner reviews and changes this list; releases bake his confirmations in (see [Testing checklist](testing-checklist.md)).

## The stages

- **Stable:** the owner has confirmed it works.
- **Beta (New):** built and passing the automated tests, not yet confirmed. In the production version, marked **New**, with an off switch in Settings → This app → Features.
- **In progress (dev):** still being built. Only in the development version.

## The two versions

- **Production** (`Dayspring.zip` on the normal releases): stable and beta features.
- **Development** (`Dayspring-dev.zip` on pre-releases, tagged like `v1.7.0-dev.1`): everything. The source checkout counts as development.
- Settings → Updates → **Which versions** picks the channel. Going from development back to production offers the newest production version, with a backup first.
- In a production build, an in-progress feature can only be tried by the developer (the developer preview token), one feature at a time from Settings → Features. Editing files in `data/` can't switch one on.

## Beta (New) features

- **Money review (read-only)** (`money`, since 1.6.0): Reads bank, Venmo or Cash App transactions or a downloaded statement and explains where the money went. Never pays or changes anything. Hidden when off: routes `/api/money`; pages `/money.html`; 1 AI tool pattern; intents `money.`.
- **Pictures from the web** (`images`, since 1.6.0): "Show me pictures of…": a numbered grid on the screen, view, save, more like this. Hidden when off: routes `/api/images`; 3 AI tool patterns; intents `images.`; 1 screen element.
- **Picture descriptions** (`vision`, since 1.6.0): "Describe this picture" and "what does this say?" for your photos, the photo on the screen and web pictures. Hidden when off: routes `/api/vision`, `/api/vision/describe`; 2 AI tool patterns; Settings `photos`.
- **Faces and people** (`faces`, since 1.6.0): Recognising the people in your own photos (off until turned on), "Who's in this picture?", the People page and profiles. Hidden when off: routes `/api/vision`, `/api/people`; pages `/people.html`; 6 AI tool patterns; Settings `photos`; jobs `vision.start`.
- **Your own music and videos** (`medialib`, since 1.6.0): "Play … from my computer", shuffling a folder, finding a video, the media list on the screen. Hidden when off: routes `/api/media/local`; 1 AI tool pattern; intents `medialib.`; 1 screen element; jobs `medialib.sources`, `medialib.scan`.
- **Google Drive** (`drive`, since 1.6.0): Searching, playing and managing files in one or more Google Drives. Hidden when off: routes `/api/drive`; 1 AI tool pattern; intents `medialib.drive`.
- **Meeting notes** (`meetnotes`, since 1.6.0): Notes and a summary of a Google Meet (announced first, off-the-record parts skipped), Past meetings. Hidden when off: routes `/api/meet/notes`; 5 screen elements.
- **Google Meet invitations** (`meetinvite`, since 1.6.1): "Set up a Google Meet with … tomorrow at 7": read back, your yes, then Google emails the invitations. Hidden when off: routes `/api/mail/invite`; 3 AI tool patterns.
- **Moving the screen** (`screenmove`, since 1.7.0): Move the open Dayspring screen to another display from Settings → Screen or by voice ("move Dayspring to the TV"). Hidden when off: checks `features.on()` in its own code.
- **Pop-ups fit the screen margins** (`popfit`, since 1.6.1): Every notice, card, menu and dialog stays inside the margins set in Settings → Screen. Hidden when off: a stylesheet.
- **Your requests come first (the floor)** (`floor`, since 1.6.0): While you talk, what Dayspring planned to say waits, then comes out one at a time; "what were you going to say?". Hidden when off: 1 screen element.
- **Spotify plays what you asked for** (`spotifyresolver`, since 1.6.0): The best Spotify match for what was asked (checked, typos fixed), not just the first search result. Hidden when off: checks `features.on()` in its own code.
- **Developer preview** (`devpreview`, since 1.6.0): On the developer's own computer only (signed, computer-bound token): every badge's art and every character. Hidden when off: routes `/api/dev`.

Hidden when off: routes `/api/smarthome`, `/api/home`, `/api/devices/home`, `/api/smart`; pages `/smarthome.html`; 5 AI tool patterns; intents `devices.`, `home.device`, `scene.`; Settings `devices`, `home`; 2 screen elements; jobs `devices.schedules`, `devices.poll`.
- **3D printers** (`printers`, since 1.7.0): Bambu Lab (LAN) and Creality Ender 5 Plus (USB, OctoPrint or Klipper): status, camera, pause, start with a bed-clear check and your yes. Hidden when off: routes `/api/printers`; pages `/printers.html`; 2 AI tool patterns; intents `printers.`, `printer.`; Settings `printers`; 2 screen elements; jobs `printers.poll`.
- **Cameras** (`cameras`, since 1.7.0): Webcams, IP cameras (RTSP / ONVIF), GoPro, printer cameras and trail cameras: live view, snapshots, motion alerts, recordings. Hidden when off: routes `/api/cameras`; pages `/cameras.html`; 2 AI tool patterns; intents `cameras.`, `camera.`; Settings `cameras`; 2 screen elements; jobs `cameras.monitor`, `cameras.record`.
- **Multi-device remote control** (`remote`, since 1.7.0): Several Dayspring computers linked securely: control one from another ("turn on my home computer" from the laptop). Hidden when off: routes `/api/remote`; pages `/remote-view.html`; 1 AI tool pattern; intents `remote.`; Settings `remote`, `signin`; jobs `remote.engine`.
- **Sharing with friends** (`social`, since 1.6.0): Sharing memories with friends. Also behind its own developer switch (lib/social/flag.mjs); off by default even in development. Hidden when off: checks `features.on()` in its own code.

## Stable features

- **Schedule and calendar** (`schedule`, since 1.0.0): Day, week, month and year views, repeating items, editing by voice, drag to move, overnight items, conflicts between calendars.
- **Voice and talking** (`voice`, since 1.0.0): The wake word, Talk, typing, spoken replies, the no-AI understanding of everyday requests and the AI conversation.
- **Alarms** (`alarms`, since 1.0.0): The morning alarm and spoken alarms, snooze, and ringing from the desktop helper when no screen is open.
- **Reminders** (`reminders`, since 1.0.0): "Remind me to…" at a time or in a while, announced on time, snoozable.
- **Timers** (`timers`, since 1.3.0): Up to seven named timers at once, with cards on the screen.
- **Weather** (`weather`, since 1.0.0): The forecast on the screen and in the morning briefing, weather alerts.
- **Music (Spotify and YouTube)** (`music`, since 1.0.0): Spotify and YouTube by voice, the in-app player, the Pop out button.
- **Recipes and cooking** (`recipes`, since 1.3.0): Saving recipes, cooking mode with steps, scaling and step timers.
- **Jokes and fun** (`jokes`, since 1.3.0): Jokes, knock-knock, trivia and games.
- **Personalities** (`personality`, since 1.4.0): Characters, sliders, custom personas and the secret characters.
- **XP and badges** (`xp`, since 1.4.0): XP from confirmed check-ins, levels, streaks and the badge collection.
- **Lantern bridge** (`lantern`, since 1.1.0): Works with Lantern: courses, lessons, one voice and one ear, XP from verified learning.
- **Calls, Tune in and Discord** (`calls`, since 1.0.0): Tune in to calls, answer into the call, Settings → Calls, the Discord bot and chat companion.
- **Meetings with Dayspring and Lantern** (`meetings`, since 1.5.0): Joining a Google Meet, who can ask, answers aloud and in chat, Lantern answering course questions, demo mode.
- **The screen layout** (`screen`, since 1.0.0): The Dayspring screen, Dayspring mini, open modes, the living sky, Fit to screen.
- **Desktop notifications** (`notifications`, since 1.2.0): Top-right notification cards, notification modes, Active / Quiet / Off.
- **Settings and setup** (`settings`, since 1.0.0): The guided setup and the Settings page.
- **Updates** (`updates`, since 1.0.1): Checking, downloading and installing new versions with backups and automatic rollback; the update channel.
- **File permissions and fail-safes** (`permissions`, since 1.6.0): What Dayspring may do with files, asking before changes, the Recycle Bin, the protected places.
- **Activity log** (`activity`, since 1.6.0): Every command, tool call and file change, with what changed and how to undo it.
- **Faith** (`faith`, since 1.0.0): Devotion, prayer list, Bible reading in any available version, Scripture memory, church.
- **Calendars and connected apps** (`connections`, since 1.0.0): Google and Microsoft calendars, subscriptions, Notion; drafts only, never sent.

## For developers: the one gate

Everything a feature has asks `features.on("<id>")` (`lib/features.mjs`). The registry entry lists what that hides: its `/api` routes answer 404 (server.mjs), its AI tools are left out of `toolsFor` and refused by `runTool` (assistant.mjs), its no-AI intents are skipped (lib/intents/match.mjs), its Settings sections are hidden (public/setup.js), its screen elements are hidden before the page draws (`/api/features/gate.js`, which also sets `window.dsFeatures.on(id)`), and its background jobs are started with `features.startJob(id, name, fn)`, which does nothing while it's off.

```js
import { on } from "./features.mjs";      // or: const F = await import("../features.mjs")
if (!on("email")) return null;             // at every entry point
```
